sentences.text: 4. Accordingly, the IA stands disposed of.
This is an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail pending suspension of further execution of sentence till disposal of the appeal.

2. Heard, Mr. G.K. Nanda, learned counsel for the appellant-petitioner and Mr. T.K. Praharaj,
learned Standing Counsel in the matter and perused the record.
None appears for the victim despite being duly informed as submitted by learned Standing Counsel.

3. It appears from the record that the present appellant-petitioner has been convicted for offences punishable Under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n) of the IPC and Sec. 6 of POCSO Act, but the maximum substantive sentence of imprisonment as awarded to the convict is for rigorous Dhira @ Prafulla Naik vs State Of Odisha on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156491687/
1 imprisonment for ten years.
4.

sentences.text: It is also found from the record that the appellant has already undergone an imprisonment for near about 1 year 6 months during trial and post conviction stage.
This Court also perused the evidence of witnesses including that of the victim.

5. After having considered the rival submissions on the backdrop of facts stated above and on going through the materials placed on record including the evidence of the victim and regard being had to the finding of the learned trial Court and the grounds under which the evidence of witnesses have been impeached and taking into account the sum totality of the factors involved in this case and lastly, there being bleak possibility of taking of hearing of this appeal in near future, this Court considers that the appellant-petitioner has made out a case for grant of bail.

6. Hence, the appellant-petitioner is allowed to go on bail, but subject to condition of his furnishing bail bonds in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five thousand) with two solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned convicting Court on such terms and conditions as deem fit and proper by it.

7. The I.A. stands disposed of.
